save_conversations: save a list of multi-speaker conversations to a JSONL file with metadata
load_conversations: load conversations from a JSONL file using the Conversations class constructor
get_conversation_count: get the number of conversations loaded using len on the Conversations object
access_conversation_metadata: access speaker names, saved options, and extra data from conversation metadata
index_conversation_turns: index into a specific conversation and access individual turn id and text
